draft_en.subject: A PoE switch SKU next to the C4Line extender range - under your label
draft_en.body:
Hi Gun,

We wrote to you once in February 2025 about an industrial PoE switch, and since then only general product mails - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 25 September 2026 - none of which needed an answer. This one is specific.

Extenders are yours and we do not build them. To sit next to the C4Line range under your label from small lots, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); DIN-rail industrial 4 x Gigabit PoE+ + 1 x Gigabit + 1 x SFP, unmanaged, -40 to 75 C - STI-154GP - $40.8. KC stays on your side.

One question: is a PoE switch SKU something your OEM/ODM roadmap covers for 2027, or do you keep the range extender-only?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
